In this experiment, you will investigate the transfer of thermal energy between hot water in a
beaker and cold water in a glass tube.
Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 2.1.

Pour 300 cm3 of hot water into the beaker.
In the first row of Table 2.1, for t = 0, record the temperature θC of the water in the glass tube
and the temperature θH of the water in the beaker.
Place the glass tube in the beaker and immediately start the stopclock.
